name: Knapp Family Farm
description: In 868 Gallia Pike, OH, Knapp Family Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on an independent pumpkin patch. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through spring, summer, and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
